entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis de Quintanar Soto y Ruiz was a Mexican soldier and statesman who briefly served as part of a triumvirate which exercised the nation's executive power for a few days at the end of 1829 after the overthrow of President Vicente Guerrero.
